opening.argument: The course is presented as practical accounting instruction, beginning with “Hello, welcome to GST Accounting course using Sage UBS 2015.” It then teaches viewers how to enter GST purchasing and sales transactions and post those transactions to accounting, while covering mandatory fields in valid GST source documents. The instruction continues through generating GST reports, GST returns, and audit files. That structured focus on configuring and operating accounting procedures, identified as “GST Accounting with Sage UBS,” establishes an educational technology demonstration, with no investment, payment, credential, or diversion offer described.

citations.quote: Hello, welcome to GST Accounting course using Sage UBS 2015.

In this lesson, you will learn 3 important key areas. 1. How do you enter GST related purchasing entries? 2. How do you enter GST-related sales entries? 3. How do you post the transactions to accounting?
Print control and generate all GST related reports such as the goods and service tax report, GST return and GST audit file.
